sources.title: The Watches of Grand Theft Auto 6 (And the Real-Life Watches They're Based On)

verified_facts.fact: Grand Theft Auto VI was released (Esquire, published 19 Nov 2026: 'has finally arrived').
The game reportedly features 34 'collectible' luxury watches.
In-game brands: Crowex ('a dead ringer for Rolex'), Takio ('distinctly Casio-adjacent'), Covgari (owes more to Audemars Piguet).
The gold Crowex is 'a near dead ringer' for the Rolex Day-Date 40, ref. 228238: fluted bezel, black dial, day window at 12; bracelet differs from the President.
A silver chronograph worn by a character overlooking Vice City resembles the Rolex Daytona (round case, contrasting subdials, metal bracelet).
Brian Heder, a veteran drug smuggler, wears a metal sports watch that recalls the Rolex Submariner.
Jason Duval, one of the two protagonists, wears a chunky digital watch resembling Casio's Pro Trek range.
The Takio F-BLAST is a nod to Casio's digital classics, especially the F-91W (spotted by Instagram account @geesgshock).
